title: Queue source tile status board
summary: Reworked the Queue source-inventory tiles into compact status-board instruments with chips, meters, semantic rails, and contained path labels.
reason: Improve operator scan speed and detail density while keeping source inventory display-only and backend launch scope unchanged.
behavior_before: Queue source inventory rendered eight plain text-heavy tiles with one label, one value, and one detail line per tile.
behavior_after: Queue source inventory renders the same eight display-only tiles with compact labels, tabular values, semantic chips, mini meter bars, and truncated path evidence backed by full title/detail text.
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue source tile renderer, Queue source tile CSS, Queue partial placeholder, and their generated summaries from this packet; no backend state or API rollback is required.
